description: This file defines the interface ProductPriceService which extends a generic service interface to manage ProductPrice entities. It declares methods to add descriptions to product prices and to save or update product prices, and throws ServiceException for error handling.

classes.name: ProductPriceService
classes.description: Interface extending SalesManagerEntityService to manage ProductPrice entities with additional methods for description management.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a ProductPriceDescription to a ProductPrice, potentially throws ServiceException.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a ProductPrice entity, potentially throws ServiceException.
